_meta.review_notes: Q09 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL) produces Aggregate -> Seq Scan on rental with Filter (return_date IS NULL) and Rows Removed by Filter=16044. SCAN-004 fires via the else branch (actual.rows=0, so rule falls back to rows_removed(16044) > min_rows_removed(500) threshold). ratio_str becomes INFINITY -> 'inf' in detail, with literal 'x' from template producing 'infx'. extract_filter_columns captures 'return_date' from the IS NULL pattern and feeds it into suggestion_with_cols ('ANALYZE rental; also consider CREATE INDEX ON rental (return_date)'), but the column name does NOT appear in detail. detail template: '%{node_label} on %{relation} with Filter: estimated %{estimated} rows but got %{actual} (ratio: %{ratio}x)' with appended ', Rows Removed by Filter: 16044' when rows_removed > 0. SCAN-001 does NOT fire (Filter present -> SCAN-001 requires NO Filter). SCAN-005 does NOT fire (rule only matches IndexScan variants). GEN-001 does NOT fire (depth=2). JOIN-001 does NOT fire (no Nested Loop).

anti_findings.reason: SCAN-001 requires NO Filter on the scan (pure full scan). Q09's SeqScan has Filter (return_date IS NULL), which routes it to SCAN-004 instead.
SCAN-005 only matches IndexScan / IndexOnlyScan / CStoreIndexScan / PartitionedIndexScan. Q09 is a SeqScan.
No Nested Loop node in plan.
